repos.name: v-rpc-log
repos.role: VistA RPC Broker log viewer — the `v rpc-log` domain (renamed from `v rpc-debug` 2026-09-07, rpc-development RD-D16). Reads the Broker's native XWBDEBUG log over the m engine seam to view/save the RPC traffic a LIVE client generates: a zero-install, byte-clean observer for a site maintainer, and the independent oracle for the `v rpc-tap` capture. Not a developer's client and not for v-devbox — it intercepts nothing and needs a client to observe. The two integrate only at the v-cli busybox.

repos.name: v-rpc-tap
repos.role: VistA scalable RPC tap — the `v rpc-tap` domain. A durable, full-payload RPC-broker tap (XWBPRS splice -> per-job bounded ring -> read-only drain to S3) for high-volume capture. Ships the VSL RPC TAP M package (VSLRT* routines + KIDS build) plus the host arm/drain/validate tooling and the load-proof harness. High-risk, national Class-1-adjacent; built and proven dual-engine on our own gold-master engines before any VA offer. Sibling of the safe, read-only v-rpc-log XWBDEBUG oracle (renamed from v-rpc-debug 2026-09-07); the two integrate only at the v-cli busybox as `v rpc-log` / `v rpc-tap`.

repos.name: v-stdlib
